audit_metadata.governing_directive: We need to have understood everything related to the first model before we increase complexity.

source_modifications_classification.justification: Ensures complete invariance of mechanical residual, tangent stiffness, phase field evolution, and common block state transfer.

source_modifications_classification.modification: Updated header comment for Hooke stress evaluation
source_modifications_classification.justification: Clear documentation of error feedback purpose.

source_modifications_classification.modification: Added local double precision variables for Hookean plane-strain elasticity
source_modifications_classification.justification: Local variables required for stress tensor evaluation.

source_modifications_classification.modification: Changed default fallback integer from 71320 to 2906
source_modifications_classification.justification: Fallback for coarse mesh size in absence of PROPS(3).

source_modifications_classification.modification: Read E_MOD_U, E_NU_U from PROPS(1..2) with defaults 210.0, 0.3
source_modifications_classification.justification: Ensures companion elements evaluate stresses with identical elasticity to mechanical UEL.

source_modifications_classification.modification: Evaluates isotropic plane-strain Hooke stress and populates STRESS(1..4)
source_modifications_classification.justification: Exposes continuum stress tensor S on All_elem for Abaqus SPR/ZZ error estimator to calculate MISESERI.
Prevents double-counting structural stiffness with mechanical UEL Layer 2 (Delta K < 1e-9 kN/mm).

architectural_comparison_summary.boundary_conditions: Bottom roller uy=0, pin ux=0; Top lateral-free roller (tied to RP in DOF 2)
architectural_comparison_summary.uel_layers: Layer 1 Phase (U1/U3), Layer 2 Mech (U2/U4), Layer 3 Companion (CPE4/CPE3)
architectural_comparison_summary.stress_source: UMAT Hookean stress tensor sigma = D0 * epsilon populated on companion layer
architectural_comparison_summary.all_elem_definition: All_elem points to companion Layer 3 elements recognized by Abaqus SPR/ZZ
architectural_comparison_summary.loading_schedule: Published 2-step displacement schedule: Step-1 (0.005 mm), Step-2 (0.010 mm)
architectural_comparison_summary.miseseri_output: Whole-element centroid scalar discretization error indicator
architectural_comparison_summary.stiffness_contribution: Layer 2 carries 100% of physical stiffness (K0 = 137.945520 kN/mm); Layer 3 stiffness < 1e-11 kN/mm

twelve_metrics_implemented: 2. All_elem element count and output-position provenance
3. One MISESERI value per underlying finite element (duplicate/missing checks)
4. Global statistics (sum, mean, median, std, max, peak-to-mean)
6. Five-region statistics (Corridor, Wake, Right Ligament, Far Field, Boundary)
7. Far-field + wake share of total error
9. Transverse corridor width profile w(x) across 20 longitudinal bins
10. High-error bounding boxes (dx x dy spans)
11. Pairwise coincident discrepancy (delta, RMS, correlation r)
12. Qualitative comparison to Pandey & Kumar Fig. 6(a) spatial footprint

branches.LAYERED_JOB1_AWAY_FROM_TARGET_LOCALIZATI: Delta Share_far+wake >= +5.0% OR corridor share drops

predeclared_decision_logic.governing_rule: Raw pre-remesh MISESERI comparison must be qualified first; do not use total remeshed element count as primary acceptance criterion and do not run adaptiveRemesh yet.
